label: First in order
description: Take whichever branch spoke, in the order the inputs are written: the first input that carried a value is the one emitted, and nothing is emitted when they all stayed quiet. Its inputs are the ones you wire onto it, so `checked: review.answer` above `quick: draft.answer` prefers the checked one whenever both arrive.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The first input that spoke, in written order. Closed when none did.
